description: Presents the connected organisation’s accessible saved applications and patents as an interactive portfolio. Retrieves both categories with pagination, including drafts and standalone applications, and arranges them into patent families from existing saved family relationships. In the snapshot, groups are patent families as linked in Lightbringer and their records are applications, including granted patents; a single-application group can also be a standalone application or one with unavailable family information. The snapshot contains references, regions, types, recorded states and coverage warnings; for an application in prosecution, also the current prosecution step, who it awaits, the office action date and the open response deadline recorded in Lightbringer. Does not import, refresh families, verify current legal status or ownership, or save a platform report. After successful app display, the component supplies the portfolio answer without duplicate chat listings or links. Tool success alone does not prove rendering succeeded. Text/link fallback is available when display is unavailable, denied or fails, or text is requested.
name: show_patent_portfolio

groups.description: Patent families as linked by saved family relationships in Lightbringer, not verified against official family data. A group with one application is a standalone application or an application whose family information is unavailable, as the warnings state

records.description: Applications in this patent family, including drafts and granted patents

title: Patent portfolio
